metadata.title: Claude, Create Cowork Plugin.
metadata.purpose: Answer whether asking Claude to create a Cowork plugin means it just generates the finished plugin on the spot, or something else, using the skill's real five-phase workflow (Discovery, Component Planning, Design, Implementation, Review & Package) with an invented onboarding-plugin scenario as the concrete case. Lands the carry-out that nothing gets built until the plan is confirmed.
metadata.anchor_pair: B01 -> B03 (the five-phase row planted with the invented onboarding-plugin example; paid off showing files appear only at phase 4, plus the 'whatever's best' flip)

beats.narration_text: Someone asks Claude to create a plugin, expecting it to just make one on the spot. It doesn't — first it plans. So what actually happens before Claude writes a single file?

shot.new_visual_element: Writer types 'Ask Claude to create a plugin — does it just make it?', hesitates on 'make', corrects to 'plan', lands the real question

beats.note: B00 is Remotion (BrutalistHesitantWriter) per hai-simple SKILL.md WRITER LAW. TIMING LAW: 31-word narration + lead_silence_s 0.8 to give the typing a >=9s window; verify media/B00.mp4 >= 8s and that the correction ('make' -> 'plan') is visible on a late frame.

beats.act: 1 stakes / 2 wrong guess, falsified / 4 ANCHOR PLANTED
beats.narration_text: Ask for a new plugin — say, one that onboards new hires — and Claude doesn't start writing files. It runs five phases in order: Discovery, Component Planning, Design, Implementation, then Review and Package. Discovery comes first: what should this plugin do, and who's going to use it.

shot.new_visual_element: THE ANCHOR — five phase cards draw in left to right; only Phase 1 lights up, the onboarding-plugin example typing in beneath it; the other four stay blank

production_viz.label: THE ANCHOR — five phases, one lit
production_viz.mechanic: Five small numbered cards labelled Discovery / Plan / Design / Build / Package draw in left to right on cream. Only card 1 (Discovery) gets a teal outline and lights up; cards 2-5 stay flat grey outlines, empty. THE ANCHOR. Beneath card 1, a short italic line types itself out: "a plugin that onboards new hires." A caption beneath the row reads 'nothing written yet.' No file icon, no gear, anywhere in frame. THIS EXACT FIVE-CARD ROW RETURNS AT B03.

beats.narration_text: Next it plans components: does the plugin need a skill for know-how, an MCP server for an outside tool, an agent for a multi-step task, a hook that fires on its own? For the onboarding plugin, that means one skill for the checklist and a connector to the HR system — laid out in a table, waiting on your confirmation.

shot.new_visual_element: A four-row component table — Skill / MCP / Agent / Hook — Skill and MCP get a check, Agent and Hook get a faint cross, the table sits boxed, waiting

production_viz.label: Which pieces?
production_viz.mechanic: A boxed table card draws in with four rows: 'Skill — know-how or an action', 'MCP server — reach an outside tool', 'Agent — multi-step task', 'Hook — fires automatically'. For the onboarding-plugin anchor, a teal check mark lands beside Skill, then beside MCP server. A faint terracotta cross lands beside Agent, then Hook — decided against, not built. The whole table card gets a dashed outline and a small caption beneath: 'waiting on your confirm.'

beats.narration_text: Only after you confirm that plan does Implementation start — every file gets written in one pass, matching exactly what was agreed. Say "whatever you think is best" instead of choosing, and Claude doesn't stall — it gives a specific recommendation and still waits for your yes before writing anything. Either way, the onboarding plugin exists as a file only once you've said go.

shot.new_visual_element: THE ANCHOR RETURNS — the five-phase row from B01, now with checks through phase 3; file icons appear ONLY at phase 4; a second branch shows a recommendation card popping up before the same gate opens

production_viz.label: THE ANCHOR RETURNS — build, only after yes
production_viz.mechanic: THE B01 FIVE-CARD ROW RETURNS, identical layout. Teal checks land on cards 1, 2, 3 (Discovery, Plan, Design) in sequence. Only then, on card 4 (Build), small file icons fade in one by one — the first file icon anywhere in the whole reel appears exactly here, never earlier. Card 5 (Package) gets a small zip icon last. Beneath the row, a second branch draws in: a small card reading '"whatever's best"' with an arrow to a recommendation card, which still needs its own teal check before the same card-4 file icons are allowed to appear. Caption: 'still waits for a yes.'

beats.narration_text: Ask Claude to create a plugin, and it doesn't just write one — it walks five phases first, and nothing gets built until you've confirmed the plan.

props.quote: Ask Claude to create a plugin, and it doesn't just write one — it walks five phases first, and nothing gets built until you've confirmed the plan.

beats.narration_text: Your turn. Here's the prompt — read it with me. Ask Claude to build you something you actually want — a plugin, a script, a short doc. Before it writes anything, ask it to lay out its plan in phases and wait for your yes. Then watch: does it ask real questions, or does it just guess and go? Liam, in for Bear.

props.command: Before you build anything I ask for, lay out your plan in phases first and wait for my yes before writing a single file.
